<tool_call>
<function=analyze_strategy>
<parameter=content>
Competing brand X has drastically cut prices across its entire range, intending to undercut our market share. They are absorbing the short-term losses in exchange for long-term customer loyalty. Additionally, they have ramped up their online marketing and social media presence to attract a younger demographic, which could lead to a shift in consumer perceptions and buying patterns, potentially affecting our sales figures.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
